mapper.select: SELECT d.*, s.scene_name FROM device_info d LEFT JOIN scene_info s ON d.scene_id = s.id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM device_info WHERE status = #{status} AND deleted = 0

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS online, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS busy, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS offline, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS fault, CAST(COUNT(1) AS SIGNED) AS total FROM device_info WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS busy, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offline, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fault FROM device_info WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.date_day, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT tdr.device_id) AS usedDevices FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS date_day FROM (SELECT 0 n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 UNION SELECT 13 UNION SELECT 14 UNION SELECT 15 UNION SELECT 16 UNION SELECT 17 UNION SELECT 18 UNION SELECT 19 UNION SELECT 20 UNION SELECT 21 UNION SELECT 22 UNION SELECT 23 UNION SELECT 24 UNION SELECT 25 UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29) n WHERE n.n < #{days} ) t LEFT JOIN task_device_rel tdr ON DATE(tdr.assign_time) = t.date_day GROUP BY t.date_day ORDER BY t.date_day ASC

SELECT s.scene_name, COUNT(d.id) AS deviceCount FROM scene_info s LEFT JOIN device_info d ON d.scene_id = s.id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.id, s.scene_name ORDER BY deviceCount DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_info(device_name, device_code, device_type, scene_id, ip_address, model, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{deviceName}, #{deviceCode}, #{deviceType}, #{sceneId}, #{ipAddress}, #{modelSpec}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE device_info SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE device_info SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
